data.coordinate_scope: CA atom of observed canonical protein residues; exact shared residue IDs in either common joint row order; proper rigid rotations,not reflections.
data.coverage_policy: Report fraction of the76-reference-residue scope represented by shared CA IDs. A full-reference comparison is supported only if coverage>=0.90; still report the descriptive fitted RMSD over the observed shared scope.

source_provenance.data_scope: Unmodified full reference PDB and a labelled derived coordinate audit file. The audit file is not a new experimental structure or a validated protein conformation.

provenance.kind: Public historical records and/or explicitly disclosed derived audit inputs; source-specific provenance is in the study record. Controlled numerical teaching fixtures make no experimental observation claim.
